_provenance.method: read of this target's scripts/scripts.js + scripts/aem.js + head.html

notes: decorateButtons requires authored <strong> (primary), <em> (secondary) or both (accent); a bare link in a p is NOT buttonized.
decorateButtons skips links containing an and links whose p has other text.
buildAutoBlocks auto-blocks a[href*='/fragments/'] and a[href*='/widgets/'] (buildWidgetAutoBlocks). No NAB href contains either segment, so no auto-block collision.

head.html sets a strict CSP with require-trusted-types-for 'script'; scripts.js installs a default trusted-types policy that strips <script> from createContextualFragment sinks. Inline scripts in authored content are inert.
styles.css ships body{display:none} + body.appear{display:block}; loadEager adds .appear. Keep the gate.
loadFonts() loads styles/fonts.css eagerly at >=900px or on repeat views, always in loadLazy.
